notes: All values read directly from card images. Where text is partially obscured by overlap or low contrast, marked as 'partial'.

cards.name: Underworld Guardian
cards.text:
When encountered, you must defeat this or take 2 damage.
DEFEAT: Take the 2x artifact enhancer.
TROPHY: Bonus artifact. (doesn't count for your artifact limit.)
cards.notes: Permanent boss monster on the Underworld board. Aka 'Kerberos'. Defeating gives the 2x artifact enhancer.

cards.name: Tome of the Ape Lords
cards.text: If you have a monkey idol, this counts as a Secret Tome.
cards.flavor: Ape Lord magic was divided into three schools.

cards.name: Tome of Intellect
cards.text: Draw two cards. It counts as a Secret Tome.
cards.flavor: It's an exciting read. The words jump off the page.

cards.name: Underworld Guide
cards.text:
If you're in the Underworld, draw a card.
When you trash this, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Ask him no questions... but you'd best read the fine print.
cards.notes: Trash-for-draw companion. The 'when you trash this' clause makes it a great early-game pick — works in any Trash device.

cards.name: Soul Prism
cards.text: When you trash this, free a prisoner.
cards.flavor: If you listen closely, you can hear tiny hands knocking.
cards.notes: Cheap 2-skill card that doubles as a Prisoner-source when trashed. Dragon attack on acquire.

cards.name: Oracle
cards.text:
Draw a card.
-OR-
Spend 1 coin to draw two cards.
cards.flavor: Tips make the visions a little clearer.

cards.name: Lantern
cards.text: [partial: coin/clank effect — exact text obscured]
cards.flavor: The Underworld is a dangerous place... [obscured]
cards.notes: PARTIAL EXTRACTION — card was on the left edge of image, cost and main effect not fully readable. Yellow boot icon visible = produces 1 Boot. Bottom shows a coin icon with '1'.

cards.name: Big Ideas
cards.text:
+1 Clank!
If you generate 6 or more [Skill] this turn, [obscured effect]
cards.flavor: It's dumb enough that it might be brilliant.
cards.notes: PARTIAL — bottom-right cost obscured. Visible: Skill 2, VP 1, makes +1 Clank, threshold-conditional effect at 6 skill.

cards.name: Wealth of Knowledge
cards.text:
ARRIVE: All players get 1 coin.
Worth 1 [point] for each Secret Tome you have.
cards.flavor: Unlock the riches of your [obscured]
cards.notes: PARTIAL — cost hidden by overlap. Variable VP that scales with Secret Tome count. Strong with the Imp Assistant / Tome strategy.

cards.name: Moneychanger's Booth
cards.text: USE: [Get 2 coins — exact wording obscured]
cards.flavor: It's a great deal. Trinkets from the upper world for access to the underworld.
cards.notes: PARTIAL — device cost 4, but the USE benefit text partially obscured.

cards.name: Fire Breath
cards.text: If you make any Clank! this turn, draw a card.
cards.flavor: Mages everywhere are chatting about this hot new spell.
cards.notes: Cost not readable in image. Stat line strong: 1 Skill + 1 Sword + Clank-trigger draw.

cards.name: Abyssal Hydra
cards.text:
ARRIVE: Put 6 coin on this.
DEFEAT: Draw two cards, take 2 coin from this. This stays in the dungeon row if it still has any coin.
cards.flavor: That is one hale hydra.
cards.notes: Persistent monster — sticks in dungeon row until coin pool empty (drained 2 at a time, ~3 fights). Big payoff for sword-heavy decks.

cards.name: Harpy Matriarch
cards.text:
Fight this only in the Underworld.
DEFEAT: 2 coin
TROPHY: Worth 1 [point] for each harpy trophy you have (including this one).
cards.flavor: Mess with her brood, and you're messing with her.
cards.notes: Underworld-only monster. Trophy mechanic scales — if you defeat multiple Harpies (this + Harpy tokens from board), each is worth more. Quadratic scaling in some sense.

cards.name: Acid Splash
cards.text:
Reveal the top card of your deck. (Reshuffle if needed.)
Then choose: Trash it -OR- discard it to get 2 coin.
cards.flavor: This is a highly volatile spell.
cards.notes: Cheap trash card — major thinning effect at 2 cost. The 'or 2 coin' fallback means it's never dead.

cards.name: Cyclops
cards.text:
ARRIVE: All players get +1 Clank!
DEFEAT: Take a lockpick, trash a card in your play area or discard pile.
cards.flavor: Don't worry about the boulder. He doesn't have good depth perception.
cards.notes: High-value monster — lockpick + trash for 3 swords. The +1 Clank on arrival hurts all players (good in multiplayer).

cards.name: Grave Robber
cards.text:
ARRIVE: Rotate each square tile with any players on it 180 degrees.
DEFEAT: 1 coin
cards.flavor: In the Underworld lies grave danger.
cards.notes: Disruption monster — the tile rotation can severely mess with opponents' planned routes.

cards.name: Shifting Shadow
cards.text: DEFEAT: You may move in the wrong direction through one-way tunnels this turn.
cards.flavor: Invisible to most, these creatures dwell on the edge of the living world and the ghost world.
cards.notes: Cheap 1-sword monster. Defeat reward situational but useful in tight maps.

cards.name: Wild Boar
cards.text:
DANGER: Pull +1 cube for dragon attacks.
DEFEAT: +1 Clank!, draw two cards.
cards.flavor: Best not stand in its path...
cards.notes: DANGER card — increases dragon attack pull while in row. Defeat is huge (draw 2) but you also +1 your own Clank.

cards.name: Soothsayer
cards.text: If you have a fate card, +1 coin.
cards.arrive: Each player may spend 1 coin to heal.
cards.flavor: The future is coming soon.
cards.notes: Solid 3-cost companion (2 Skill / 2 VP) with Fate synergy. The Arrive heal-for-coin is communal.

cards.name: Catapult
cards.text: USE: +2 Clank!, teleport to an adjacent room.
cards.flavor: I have an idea. Hold my tankard.
cards.notes: Cheap teleport device — +2 Clank cost. Dragon attack on acquire.

cards.name: Orpheus
cards.text:
+1 Clank!, 1 coin
Worth 1 [point] for each freed Prisoner you have.
cards.arrive: Put 3 dragon cubes back in the bag.
cards.notes: Major 7-cost companion. Arrive removes 3 dragon cubes from bag (huge defense), Acquire frees a prisoner, end-game scales with prisoners. Premium card.

cards.name: Mystic Elevator
cards.text: USE: +1 Clank!, teleport to a Market room in the Underworld.
cards.flavor: Going down?
cards.notes: Underworld-Market shortcut device. Useful for fast Underworld access.

cards.name: Utility Knife
cards.text: Draw a card.
cards.flavor: It slices, it dices, it transfers wealth... but wait, there's more!
cards.notes: Cheap utility — 1 sword + 1 card draw for 3 skill.

tokens.name: Imp Assistant (4x)
tokens.value: x4 VP per Secret Tome at end of game
tokens.drawback: When you acquire a Secret Tome, must remove 2 cards from the Dungeon Row (may trigger dragon attack)
tokens.notes: There are 3 different Imp Assistants placed in the Forbidden Library at start of game. Multipliers likely 2x/3x/4x. Player can only carry one.

tokens.name: Artifact Enhancer 2x
tokens.value: Doubles the value of your highest-VP artifact at end of game
tokens.notes: Awarded to the player who defeats the Underworld Guardian (Kerberos).

tokens.name: Artifact Enhancer 1.5x
tokens.value: 1.5x your highest-VP artifact at end of game
tokens.notes: Two copies — awarded to the next two players who enter the Guardian's room after he's defeated.
